notes: Single source of truth for protocol signatures and brand hints. Used by the Linux app directly and bundled into the Android app at build time. Discovery only proves a device advertises a protocol; it never proves SpeakerBridge can play audio on it. Verified playback is recorded per-device by the user (verified.json on Linux, app storage on Android).

googlecast.label: Google Cast
googlecast.native_multiroom: Cast speaker groups made in the Google Home app play in sync, including third-party speakers with Chromecast built-in (many Sony and Vizio soundbars).
googlecast.notes: Receives audio by URL (an HTTP stream served by SpeakerBridge). Buffers several seconds, so it suits music; it is not suitable for lip-synced TV audio.

airplay.label: AirPlay
airplay.native_multiroom: AirPlay 2 receivers can share a timeline when the sender supports AirPlay 2.
airplay.notes: Open-source senders exist (e.g. via PipeWire's RAOP module for AirPlay 1). AirPlay 2 sending from Linux is less mature.

raop.label: AirPlay audio (RAOP)
raop.notes: PipeWire can stream to RAOP receivers directly with module-raop-discover, which makes this a strong early Linux target.

dlna_renderer.label: DLNA / UPnP renderer
dlna_renderer.notes: Plays a URL you hand it. No shared clock, so multi-speaker sync needs calibration and may drift.

spotify_connect.label: Spotify Connect
spotify_connect.notes: Only plays Spotify's own catalog. Cannot carry system audio from SpeakerBridge.

sony_scalar.label: Sony Audio Control API
sony_scalar.notes: Sony's local control API (volume, input, power). Useful for volume control; audio itself must arrive by Cast, AirPlay or DLNA.

vizio_smartcast.label: Vizio SmartCast control
vizio_smartcast.notes: Vizio's local control interface. Audio for Vizio soundbars normally arrives via Chromecast built-in.

sonos.label: Sonos
sonos.native_multiroom: Sonos groups sync among Sonos speakers only.
sonos.notes: Many Sonos speakers also expose AirPlay 2 or a UPnP renderer, which is the realistic path.

status_labels.ready_to_test: Ready to test: has a streaming protocol SpeakerBridge will use
status_labels.control_only: Control only: found, but no protocol that accepts SpeakerBridge audio
status_labels.group: Speaker group: a Cast group made in Google Home
status_labels.not_speaker: Not a speaker (router, TV server, etc.)
